shots.title: Name today's book.
shots.text: Every day one classic from Project Gutenberg is hidden. Your job is to name it.

shots.title: Two clues.
shots.text: An emoji row and a haiku cut from the book. Each emoji you reveal costs 2 points.

shots.title: Search the shelf.
shots.text: Search among 50 books, or narrow the shelf to 30 for 10 points. Six tries, one ink drop each.

shots.title: Stamped.
shots.text: Find the book and your result is stamped. Share it and keep your streak.

shots.title: A new classic every day.
shots.text: Plus haiku, cut from the books themselves. Play at gutenku.xyz.

about.metaTitle: About GutenKu: haiku cut from classic books, and a daily guessing game
about.metaDescription: GutenKu cuts haiku from the classic books of Project Gutenberg with NLP, Markov chains and OpenAI, and runs GutenGuess, a daily book guessing game. Made by heristop.
about.title: About GutenKu.
about.lede: Haiku cut from classic books, and a daily game of guessing them.
about.what1: GutenKu turns classic literature from Project Gutenberg into haiku. Every verse is a real sentence from a public-domain book, found, cut and set in seventeen syllables.
about.what2: A new haiku is published every day, with a short reading that explains why it works.

steps.title: A book is chosen
steps.text: The library is the public-domain classics of Project Gutenberg.

steps.title: Verses are cut
steps.text: Natural language processing and Markov chains assemble candidate verses of five, seven and five syllables.

steps.title: The best is kept
steps.text: OpenAI refines the selection and writes a short reading. A neural network learns, over time, which haiku are worth keeping.

about.game: The same books, as a game. Each day one classic is hidden behind emoji and a haiku; you search a shelf and name it in six tries.
about.demoCaption: Cut from Dracula, Bram Stoker · chapter I · Project Gutenberg
